B wins slightly only on the container: an E7 Activity parent carries no P22/P23 direction claim, while A's preferred parent E8 Acquisition would either be left partyless or would restate the both-sides ambiguity A itself argues against. A's compensating strength -- finding E96's own 'instantiate per object and as part of an overall transaction' precedent, and noting that Doerr's t1224 objection was to the new class and not to Sanderson's P9 grouping -- is real but is an analogy, which A honestly flags, whereas B's grounding in P9's declared E4 domain and range is direct.
